synth.notes:
Twin cyan 4x4 blocks on a visible maze: floor colour 5, every other colour blocks; a move succeeds iff the 4x4 destination is floor (own cells excepted, rows 1-62).
A1/A2 move both blocks vertically by 4; A3: left x-4, right x+4; A4 the reverse. Each block moves on its own.
Clicking a colour-9 marker arms the blocks (10->1) and makes that marker active (11); clicking colour 1 disarms; any other click does nothing.
While armed, A1-A4 steer the active marker 4x4 cell (2x2 sprite at +1). A5 does nothing but still counts as an action.
HUD: 0-bars on row 0 (right-aligned) and row 63 (left-aligned), width 3(a+1)//7. a counts every action since level start and is carried across calls only while frames are continuous; otherwise it is recovered from the bar width.
